text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Ines Fujin slapped her cheeks, 
pumping herself up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Ryan-chan and McQueen-chan are running in 
this race too, right?"

The Tenno Sho (Spring)—a stage where the 
prestigious Mejiro family contends for an 
unyielding shield. Surely, both runners 
and supporters alike will approach this 
stage with everything they have.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to take in everything from the 
way those two run. So I can use it next 
time."
choice_data_list:
Since you've come this far, make sure you 
bring home the victory.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Oops, we've got an additional order!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to serve you with top-tier 
hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
McQueen! Ryaaan!! Show 'em what the Mejiro 
family is made of—!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Amazing. Just the two of them stepping 
out brought this much excitement...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~! You both look wonderful~! Please, 
win this by all means~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone watching Ryan-chan and the 
others has sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan and the others have been racing 
while all these eyes are glued on them...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. So these are the two who've 
carried everyone's hopes...!
